payments_amount_ck.name: payments_amount_ck
payments_amount_ck.value: "payments"."amount" >= 0 and "payments"."amount" < 'Infinity'::numeric and ("payments"."refund_amount" is null or ("payments"."refund_amount" >= 0 and "payments"."refund_amount" <= "payments"."amount"))

payments_refund_state_ck.name: payments_refund_state_ck
payments_refund_state_ck.value: ("payments"."state" = 'refunded') = ("payments"."refund_amount" is not null and "payments"."refund_amount" = "payments"."amount") and ("payments"."refund_amount" is null or "payments"."state" in ('verified', 'refunded'))

program_versions_published_at_ck.name: program_versions_published_at_ck
program_versions_published_at_ck.value: "program_versions"."status" not in ('published', 'superseded') or "program_versions"."published_at" is not null

programs_client_sub_ck.name: programs_client_sub_ck
programs_client_sub_ck.value: "programs"."client_id" is not null or "programs"."subscription_id" is null

nutrition_plan_versions_published_at_ck.name: nutrition_plan_versions_published_at_ck
nutrition_plan_versions_published_at_ck.value: "nutrition_plan_versions"."status" not in ('published', 'superseded') or "nutrition_plan_versions"."published_at" is not null

nutrition_plans_client_sub_ck.name: nutrition_plans_client_sub_ck
nutrition_plans_client_sub_ck.value: "nutrition_plans"."client_id" is not null or "nutrition_plans"."subscription_id" is null

form_versions_published_at_ck.name: form_versions_published_at_ck
form_versions_published_at_ck.value: "form_versions"."status" not in ('published', 'superseded') or "form_versions"."published_at" is not null

calendar_events_rule_ck.name: calendar_events_rule_ck
calendar_events_rule_ck.value: "calendar_events"."source" <> 'package_rule' or ("calendar_events"."rule_key" is not null and "calendar_events"."subscription_id" is not null)

workout_sessions_program_pair_ck.name: workout_sessions_program_pair_ck
workout_sessions_program_pair_ck.value: "workout_sessions"."program_version_id" is null or "workout_sessions"."program_id" is not null

media_path_ck.name: media_path_ck
media_path_ck.value:
"media"."bucket" in ('client-media', 'tenant-assets')
        and ("media"."client_id" is null) = ("media"."bucket" = 'tenant-assets')
        and "media"."path" ~ '^[A-Za-z0-9._/-]+$'
        and "media"."path" !~ '(^|/)[.]{1,2}(/|$)'
        and "media"."path" !~ '//'
        and "media"."path" !~ '/$'
        and (("media"."client_id" is null and starts_with("media"."path", "media"."tenant_id"::text || '/assets/'))
          or ("media"."client_id" is not null and starts_with("media"."path", "media"."tenant_id"::text || '/clients/' || "media"."client_id"::text || '/')))
